experiment: Stream SDK assembly hashing instead of materializing full file byte arrays
scope: Isolated standard-BCL helper projection for four SDK identity file hashes. No full compiler allocation, compilation latency, source text reading, gameplay or market comparison.
decision: Allocation improvement proven; latency and extra read-call tradeoff remain unmeasured. Production unchanged.
limits: The helper body is copied exactly from the source-only candidate; the complete candidate compiler SDK has not been built or validated.
No inference that lower allocations mean lower compile latency. Stream hashing can use more IO calls.
Current schema-file and already-captured image hashing are untouched.
File sharing, error type/HResult and handle release verified on this Mac; no Windows-specific validation.
All raw GC counts retained. One ABBA campaign per profile, no universal pause or resident-memory claim.
